CustomField.description: The organizing models this template applies to. Stored as a semicolon-separated string: Seasonal, GivingPrograms, Strategy. Used by FQS_CampaignHierarchyBuilder to filter templates by model. MultiselectPicklist is not supported on CMDT, so this is a Text field with a known value set enforced by convention. WARNING: Uses substring matching in Apex (`LIKE '%model%'`) and Flow (`Contains`) — avoid values that are substrings of one another (e.g., 'Seasonal' vs. future 'SeasonalV2').
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Semicolon-separated list of models for which this template applies. Valid values: Seasonal, GivingPrograms, Strategy. Example: "Seasonal;Strategy". The Apex builder filters using LIKE queries on this field.
CustomField.label: Applicable Models
